title: [supabase/supabase] Fix issue #49009: cron toggle refresh shows stale status
description:
Fix GitHub issue #49009 in supabase/supabase:
https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues/49009

Repo:
https://github.com/supabase/supabase

Fix the Supabase Studio cron-jobs table so enabling or disabling a cron through the row switch refreshes and displays the current status instead of leaving the old status until a separate manual refresh. Keep the change focused and add regression coverage for the refresh/state update path.

Required deliverables:
- A real code submission, not analysis only.
- An upstream pull request against supabase/supabase linked to issue #49009.
- Commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes in the OpenJobs submission.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or a linked issue comment.
- Mention this exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL in the PR body or a linked issue comment.
- Clearly reference the GitHub issue URL above.
